ItemID: NA; Title: 130 PC. Dual Wall Adhesive Marine Heat Shrink Kit - 3:1 Shrink Ratio - Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to insulate and seal connections made with my crimp terminals.

ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for rigid repairs where my duct tape or vinyl cement would not suit the material.
